For Respondents : Mrs.Salomi (for R1)
Mr.P.Suresh Srinivasan (for  COMMON ORDER
This petition is filed to condone the delay of 1538 days in filing the Civil Miscellaneous appeal.
2.The injured claimant is the petitioner herein.

He has filed MCOP No.22 of 2010, before the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal [Principal District Judge], Chengalpattu, for claiming compensation and after trial, a sum of Rs.9,19,997/- was awarded on 27.03.2015.

entities.text: Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal [Principal District Judge], Chengalpattu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The insurance company also deposited the amount in the same year and the amount is also withdrawn.
After waiting for the six long years, the present application is filed.
_ _ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
3. Counter affidavit has been filed by the 2nd respondent-Insurance Company.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner/appellant, the learned counsel for the 1st respondent as well as the learned counsel for 2nd respondent-Insurance company and perused the counter affidavit.
5.
After perusing the affidavit, I do not find any valid reason much less sufficient cause to condone the huge delay of 1538 days.
Therefore, the Civil Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed and the Civil Miscellaneous Appeal in CMA SR.No.39510 of 2021, stands rejected at the SR stage itself.
No Costs.
